report.markdown:
# Chernobyl Disaster Overview

## Overview

The Chernobyl disaster occurred in the year 1986. [1][2][3] One source reports that the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant is located near the abandoned city of Pripyat in northern Ukraine. [4]

## Sources

1. [https://www.britannica.com/event/Chernobyl-disaster](https://www.britannica.com/event/Chernobyl-disaster) — britannica.com, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [Chernobyl - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl) — wikipedia.org, published 2001-08-13, fetched 2026-10-31
3. [This Happened — April 26: Chernobyl Nuclear Disaster - Worldcrunch](https://worldcrunch.com/this-happened/chernobyl-nuclear-disaster-photo) — worldcrunch.com, published 2024-04-26, fetched 2026-10-31
4. [Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl_Nuclear_Power_Plant) — wikipedia.org, published 2004-12-03, fetched 2026-10-31

evidence.quote: The Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant ( ChNPP ) is a former nuclear power plant undergoing decommissioning . ChNPP is located near the abandoned city of Pripyat in northern Ukraine , 16.5 kilometres (10 mi) northwest of the city of Chernobyl , 16 kilometres (10 mi) from the Belarus–Ukraine border , and about 100 kilometres (62 mi) north of Kyiv .

evidence.quote: The Chernobyl nuclear disaster was a catastrophic nuclear accident that occurred on this day in 1986, on Ukrainian territory of the Soviet Union.
The Chernobyl disaster occurred on April 25 and 26, 1986, at the Chernobyl nuclear power station in Ukraine, which was then part of the Soviet Union.

Prior to being evacuated in the aftermath of the Chernobyl disaster in 1986, it was home to approximately 14,000 residents—considerably less than adjacent Pripyat , which was completely abandoned following the incident.
